title: Furnace-Spine Breaker
text: Furnace-Spine Breaker locks onto worked metal and dismantles both tool and wielder with the same crushing arms. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Maintenance becomes violence when the checklist has no final line.

defeatReward.text: Furnace-Spine Breaker is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
